headline: Executive session to review previously withheld minutes from September and October 2026 meetings.
summary: The meeting will move into executive session to review previously withheld minutes. It will adjourn directly from executive session and will not reopen to the public.

## I. CALL TO ORDER

Call to order and roll call.

## II. OPEN SESSION

Review and acceptance of the October 16, 2026 meeting minutes.

## III. MOTION TO ENTER EXECUTIVE SESSION

Motion to enter executive session pursuant to M.G.L. c. 30A, § 21(a)(7), to comply with the provisions of M.G.L. c. 30A, § 22, for the purpose of reviewing and considering approval of previously withheld executive session minutes. A roll-call vote will be taken.

The Committee will not reconvene in open session and will adjourn directly from executive session.

## IV. EXECUTIVE SESSION

Review and consideration of approval of executive session minutes for September 28, 2026; October 5, 2026; and October 6, 2026.

## V. ADJOURNMENT

Adjournment directly from executive session.
